content: The experiment was conducted on two Thai datasets, Orchid and UGWC, and one English punctuation restoration dataset, IWSLT. English punctuation restoration is similar to our Thai sentence segmentation. On the Thai sentence segmentation task, our model achieves F1 scores of 92.5% and 88.9% on the Orchid and UGWC datasets, constituting a relative error reduction of 7.4% and 10.5%, respectively. On the English punctuation task, the 2-class F1 score reached 82.7% when considering only two punctuation classes (making the task similar to sentence segmentation in Thai). Moreover, our model outperforms the model integrated with pretrained word vectors in terms of the overall F1 score on the IWSLT dataset. Based on our contributions, the local representation scheme has the highest impact on the Thai corpus, while the distant representation and CVT result in strong improvements on the English dataset.
